every benchmark instrument must pass an executable falsifiability battery before its verdicts are read: no comparison arm may be the gold function; the gate must exhibit a failing seed; discriminating coordinates are sampled, never assigned per stratum; destroying the task surface must destroy performance (compared on the pair decision+structure-signature); false-accept is always reported paired with valid-transfer retention; error attribution separates structural difficulty from surface coverage

the battery is turned on itself: a probe validated only by alarms is not validated - the no-alarm case is asserted first; a negative control on a proper score over a decision space with abstention is restricted to jointly decisive items

failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:instrument-not-probative - gold-arm identity, serialization identity, or template inversion makes a passing gate carry no content
failure:CROSS.BENCHMARK.v0:probe-measures-wrong-quantity - a registered negative control computes a different quantity than registered (e.g. differential abstention instead of label binding)
falsifiers: show that a packet's freeze timestamp does not precede the candidate's construction; one such case voids the claim class
exhibit a gate no seed can fail, or a comparison arm with zero variance, or a text-destruction probe that changes nothing - any one refutes the instrument's probative reading

an instrument may satisfy every falsifiability requirement and still fail its content gate honestly (template inversion); a repair that widens the instrument toward a perfect score while errors vanish is refuted as a repair
